label: VERIFIED
extraction: Claude Code permissions system controls tool access. Permission rules use server name for MCP rules (e.g., 'mcp:github:*'), Agent(AgentName) for subagent control. PreToolUse hooks run before permission prompt for every tool except EndConversation. Hook output can deny, force prompt, or skip prompt. Project settings include permission rules, hooks, .mcp.json servers (subject to approval), plugins, skills, subagents. Agent SDK additionalDirectories/add_dirs receive exceptions via --add-dir flag. Permission modes: default, dontAsk, bypassPermissions. Hooks tighten restrictions but cannot loosen past permission rules.
